features.quote: Hold constant across variants: turn budget (say 30 turns), tool interface, temperature, system prompt

behavioral 'distress' in a transcript could be persona-level mimicry of human distress text, a trained sycophancy/self-blame pattern, or something else entirely. A well-designed study should keep these separate
features.justification_quote: so the behavioral data stays useful regardless of where you land on the welfare question
